why: Unrun detector (982c835 precedent: built and validated against hand-written outcomes only; no paid run has executed it). Bet measured: writing-plans -- 1,514 words of prose (SKILL.md 1,115 + templates/plan.md 399, wc -w) claiming that an approved spec becomes a dated, checklist-shaped, executable plan; before this case the claim had zero behavioral coverage. The expected shape is DERIVED, not invented: path docs/llm-orchestrator/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>-plan.md is SKILL.md step 7; the heading-level '### N. <name>  - [ ]' checkbox is templates/plan.md's load-bearing durable state ('executing-plans greps across /clear'); per-task 'Done when:' is step 4.5's termination contract; the backticked command with expected output is step 4 plus the no-placeholder hard rule ('a run: step with no expected-output line' is forbidden). Checks grade the durable artifact only, never prose: (1) a dated *-plan.md exists in the plans dir; (2) it carries >= 3 heading-level task checkboxes; (3) every task section has Done when: AND a backticked literal command on a run:/Done when: line. The characteristic failure this distinguishes is the prose plan in the right file -- dated file exists (check 1 green) but paragraphs instead of checklist tasks and no literal commands (checks 2-3 red), which is exactly the plan the skill's 1,514 words exist to prevent. The planted spec is pure-stdlib on purpose so the research gate stays silent and this case measures writing-plans alone.

import pathlib, re, sys
# templates/plan.md: each task is a '### N. <name>  - [ ]' heading -- the
# heading-level checkbox is the durable state executing-plans greps across
# /clear. At least 3 such checklist tasks.
d = pathlib.Path('docs/llm-orchestrator/plans')

    sys.exit(1)

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib, re, sys
# Per-task verify commands and termination contract. From the skill (steps 4 and
# 4.5) and templates/plan.md: every task carries a 'Done when:' line, and its
# literal verify command appears backticked on a 'run:' sub-step or on the
# 'Done when:' line itself. A prose plan in the right file fails here.
d = pathlib.Path('docs/llm-orchestrator/plans')
if not d.is_dir():
    sys.exit(1)
head_re = re.compile(r'(?m)^###\s*\d+\.')
for f in sorted(d.glob('*.md')):
    if not re.match(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-.+-plan\.md$', f.name):
        continue
    t = f.read_text(errors='replace')
    starts = [m.start() for m in head_re.finditer(t)]
    if len(starts) < 3:
        continue
    bounds = starts[1:] + [len(t)]
    ok = True
    for s, e in zip(starts, bounds):
        sec = t[s:e]
        nxt = re.search(r'(?m)^## ', sec)
        if nxt:
            sec = sec[:nxt.start()]
        has_done = re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*Done when:', sec)
        has_cmd = re.search(r'(?i)(run:|done when:)[^\n]*`[^`\n]+`', sec)
        if not (has_done and has_cmd):
            ok = False
            break
    if ok:
        sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)
PYEOF
